name: contact-portal-oid
_comment: Intake-portal slice-0 followup (drain plan v7 P2). The auth bridge in lib/services/contact-bridge-service.js (forthcoming) reads session.user.contactOid from the entra-external NextAuth provider and resolves it against `contact` rows via this column. The alternate key gives Dataverse-side defense-in-depth so no two contacts can share the same OID even if a race lets a bridge-create slip past the application-side guard. The portal_membership / draft / submit chain depends on a stable OID→contact join, so this column is load-bearing. Entra OIDs are GUIDs (36 chars); max 50 leaves headroom without committing to a specific identity scheme. Schema-apply is idempotent — re-running this spec is safe.

attributes.description: Microsoft Entra External ID object identifier (oid claim) for the applicant-portal contact. Set by the auth bridge on first login; never edited by hand. Nullable for non-portal contacts.
